tools.name: create_new_file_with_text
tools.description: Creates a new file at the specified path within the project directory and populates it with the provided text

pathInProject.description: The relative path where the file should be created

text.description: The content to write into the new file

tools.name: execute_action_by_id
tools.description: Executes an action by its ID in JetBrains IDE editor

actionId.description: The ID of the action to execute

tools.name: execute_terminal_command
tools.description: Executes a specified shell command in the IDE's integrated terminal

tools.name: find_commit_by_message
tools.description: Searches for a commit based on the provided text or keywords in the project history

query.description: The text or keywords to search for in commit messages

tools.name: find_files_by_name_substring
tools.description: Searches for all files in the project whose names contain the specified substring

nameSubstring.description: The substring to search for in file names

tools.name: get_all_open_file_paths
tools.description: Lists full path relative paths to project root of all currently open files

tools.name: get_all_open_file_texts
tools.description: Returns text of all currently open files in the JetBrains IDE editor

tools.name: get_debugger_breakpoints
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all line breakpoints currently set in the project

tools.name: get_file_text_by_path
tools.description: Retrieves the text content of a file using its path relative to project root

pathInProject.description: The file location from project root

tools.name: get_open_in_editor_file_path
tools.description: Retrieves the absolute path of the currently active file

tools.name: get_open_in_editor_file_text
tools.description: Retrieves the complete text content of the currently active file

tools.name: get_progress_indicators
tools.description: Retrieves the status of all running progress indicators

tools.name: get_project_dependencies
tools.description: Get list of all dependencies defined in the project

tools.name: get_project_modules
tools.description: Get list of all modules in the project with their dependencies

tools.name: get_project_vcs_status
tools.description: Retrieves the current version control status of files in the project

tools.name: get_run_configurations
tools.description: Returns a list of run configurations for the current project

tools.name: get_selected_in_editor_text
tools.description: Retrieves the currently selected text from the active editor

tools.name: get_terminal_text
tools.description: Retrieves the current text content from the first active terminal

tools.name: list_available_actions
tools.description: Lists all available actions in JetBrains IDE editor

tools.name: list_directory_tree_in_folder
tools.description: Provides a hierarchical tree view of the project directory structure

pathInProject.description: The starting folder path (use '/' for project root)

tools.name: list_files_in_folder
tools.description: Lists all files and directories in the specified project folder

pathInProject.description: The folder path (use '/' for project root)

tools.name: open_file_in_editor
tools.description: Opens the specified file in the JetBrains IDE editor

filePath.description: The path of file to open (can be absolute or relative)

tools.name: replace_current_file_text
tools.description: Replaces the entire content of the currently active file

tools.name: replace_file_text_by_path
tools.description: Replaces the entire content of a specified file with new text

pathInProject.description: The path to the target file, relative to project root

tools.name: replace_selected_text
tools.description: Replaces the currently selected text in the active editor

tools.name: replace_specific_text
tools.description: Replaces specific text occurrences in a file with new text

pathInProject.description: The path to the target file, relative to project root

tools.name: run_configuration
tools.description: Run a specific run configuration in the current project

name.description: The name of the run configuration to execute

tools.name: search_in_files_content
tools.description: Searches for a text substring within all files in the project

tools.name: toggle_debugger_breakpoint
tools.description: Toggles a debugger breakpoint at the specified line in a project file

filePathInProject.description: The relative path to the file within the project

line.description: The line number where to toggle the breakpoint (1-based)

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Waits for a specified number of milliseconds

milliseconds.description: The duration to wait in milliseconds (default: 5000)
